packageRules.description: One PR a month for everything except majors, image digests included. Majors stay separate; security fixes ignore the schedule.
Hold ESLint at v9: eslint-plugin-react@7.37.5 only supports eslint up to ^9.7. Remove once it supports ESLint 10.
Hold TypeScript below 6.1: typescript-eslint@8 requires typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0. Remove once typescript-eslint supports newer versions.
